name: ResellerClub
tagline: White-label reseller hosting and domains for agencies, not end users
description: ResellerClub is a reseller-focused hosting and domain platform — built for agencies and freelancers to resell hosting under their own brand, not for typical single-site owners.
about: ResellerClub, part of the same corporate group as BigRock, is built specifically for resellers — web designers, agencies and IT freelancers who want to host multiple client sites under their own brand rather than buy hosting for a single site of their own. Its Linux reseller plans (marketed as R1 through R4) run on WHM and give each reseller full WHM/cPanel access to create and manage an unlimited number of individually branded cPanel hosting accounts for clients, with storage and bandwidth allowances that scale up by tier. Windows reseller plans run on Plesk instead, for resellers whose clients need ASP.NET.

The core differentiator is white-labeling: resellers get a brandable client control panel and storefront (the reseller "SuperSite") so end customers never see ResellerClub's name, plus a bundled domain-reseller program covering dozens of TLDs, SSL, and email/security add-ons that can be resold at the reseller's own markup. This makes it a genuinely different product from a standard shared-hosting plan — it's infrastructure to run a hosting business on, not a place to host one website.

As with most reseller hosting, the lowest advertised per-tier price is a promotional first-term rate that renews higher afterward, and the 30-day money-back guarantee applies only to a customer's first reseller hosting account — not to renewals, additional accounts, or returning customers. Anyone evaluating ResellerClub should check the current plan pricing and renewal terms directly on resellerclub.com before committing, since third-party listings of exact figures vary by region and currency.
policies: ResellerClub backs new Linux, Windows and reseller hosting accounts with a 30-day money-back guarantee, refundable in full if canceled within that window. Per ResellerClub's own terms, this guarantee is limited to a customer's first hosting account and does not extend to renewals, additional accounts purchased later, or returning customers — check the current legal agreements on resellerclub.com for the exact scope before purchasing.
